title: Emergency Contact Update Review Worksheet
subtitle: Capture contact priority, relationship, phone route, and release authority; confirm effective date and prior record supersession.
description: Emergency Contact Update records contact priority, relationship, phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession. Emergency Contact Update evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this emergency contact update evidence-based review when staff must document contact priority and relationship. Reconcile phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession before the emergency contact update handoff. Use identity-verification evidence, the prior contact snapshot, custody or release restriction reference, confirmation message, effective-date audit, and supersession log. Ask the assigned emergency contact update reviewer to confirm contact priority against the organization's policy.
